summary.headline: Orders and revenue both missed target, at 82.4% and 83.0%, and the year now stands at 87.4% of target with the required pace above recent weeks.

points.what: Orders came in at 696 against a target of 845, or 82.4% of target, down 6.1% on the prior week.
points.so_what: The week widened the quarter's shortfall rather than closing any of it.

points.what: Revenue of $49,640 was 83.0% of the weekly target, down 9.1% week on week.
points.so_what: Revenue fell more steeply than orders did, so the miss reflects lower value per order as well as fewer orders.

points.what: Orders grew 44.4% and revenue 37.3% against the same week last year, both below the 75% growth the targets assume.
points.so_what: Growth at this rate leaves attainment below 100% even though last year's level is comfortably beaten.

points.what: The cancellation rate fell 1.3 pp to 14.8%, a move the brief marks as notable and good.
points.so_what: Order quality improved while volume fell, so the revenue miss came from fewer orders rather than more cancellations.

points.what: Year-to-date revenue is 87.4% of target, and reaching the full-year target of $3,888,802 requires $76,671 a week against a current 8-week run-rate of $51,543.
points.so_what: At the current pace the full-year target is out of reach.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the mature week of 26 Jan 2026 rose 2.2 pp to 11.6%, above last year by the same margin and flagged as notable.
points.so_what: A notable move in a bad direction on order quality is the main risk to watch in the next mature weeks.

points.what: AOV of $83.71 was down 4.7% week on week and 5.5% below the same week last year, both rated bad.
points.so_what: With value per order below last year, revenue attainment rests entirely on order volume, which also fell.

points.what: The week finished behind on both measures, with orders 149 below target and revenue $10,154 below target.
points.so_what: Neither volume nor value covered the week's requirement, so the deficit carried into the quarter position.

points.what: Quarter-to-date revenue is 87.4% of target, with $412,611 of the $774,555 full-quarter target still outstanding and 6 weeks left.
points.so_what: Closing the quarter would require a weekly pace well above anything achieved in recent weeks.

points.what: Year-to-date revenue of $361,944 sits at 87.4% of the $414,155 targeted to date.
points.so_what: Both January and February to date are behind, so the year has yet to record a month at target.

points.what: APAC placed 317 orders, down 6.5% week on week, contributing -22 orders or 48.9% of the total decline.
points.so_what: Almost half the weekly drop sits in the largest region, so the shortfall is not confined to small segments.

points.what: Organic orders fell 25.9% to 83, contributing -29 orders or 64.4% of the change, the largest traffic-source driver.
points.so_what: Most of the order decline traces to a single channel rather than being spread evenly across sources.

points.what: LATAM fell 21.4% to 81 orders, contributing -22 orders, or 48.9% of the decline.
points.so_what: The smallest region weighed on the week as heavily as the largest one did.

points.what: AOV was $83.71 for the week, below both the prior week and the same week last year.
points.so_what: Read the year-on-year revenue gain as coming from more orders, not from bigger orders.

points.what: The cancellation rate of 14.8% was 1.3 pp lower than the prior week and 0.6 pp below last year.
points.so_what: Each percentage point of cancellations carries $583 of revenue, so this movement worked in revenue's favour in a week that still missed target.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the mature week of 26 Jan 2026 was 11.6%, up from 9.4% the week before.
points.so_what: Returns are not deducted from gross revenue, so this deterioration is not visible in the reported revenue figure.

points.what: New signups were 223, flat on the prior week and 3.9% below the same week last year.
points.so_what: Customer additions are not keeping step with the 44.4% year-on-year rise in orders.
